name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Decline Bench Press
steps: Set the bench to a slight decline and secure your feet under its pads.
Lie back with the dumbbell above your shoulder and your free hand on your hip.
Lower the dumbbell slowly toward the side of your lower chest with your elbow angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the dumbbell back up to full arm extension, and switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep your shoulders pinned against the bench so the single-sided load does not twist your torso.
Use a controlled tempo and stack your wrist directly over your elbow throughout the press.
